Metadata.title: NOLON
Metadata.description: NOLON logistics and shipping management system

Home.title: NOLON
Home.subtitle: Logistics and shipping management
Home.status: The environment is running. Operational modules are being built.

Login.title: Sign in to NOLON
Login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
Login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.
Login.brandTitle: Every shipment, invoice and entry in one place.
Login.brandLead: Sea and road freight, warehousing, customs, inland transport and accounting for all NOLON branches.

Shell.loadFailed: Could not reach the server. Reload the page.

Dashboard.loadFailed: Could not load the figures. Reload the page.
Dashboard.allClear: Nothing is waiting for you right now.

Account.title: Change password
Account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
Account.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
Account.rejected: The current password is wrong, or the new one is too short.
Account.failed: Could not change the password. Try again.

Users.title: Users
Users.name: Full name
Users.branchesHint: Administrator and Management see every branch; other roles need at least one.
Users.outletHint: Outlet Staff hold no other role and work for one sales outlet of their one branch.
Users.outletOneBranch: Choose exactly one branch to pick the outlet.
Users.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
Users.deactivated: User deactivated and signed out everywhere.
Users.passwordReset: Password reset. The user was signed out everywhere.
Users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out at once.
Users.emailTaken: A user with this email already exists.
Users.lastAdmin: There must always be at least one active Administrator.
Users.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
Users.branchRequired: Choose at least one role and one branch (unless the role sees all branches).
Users.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.
Users.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Users.assistantApprovalsHint: Drafts the assistant prepares for this user that they may approve or reject inside the assistant chat. They still need the usual permission for each entry. Goods receipts are always approved on the review screen.
Users.permissionsChanged: Permissions changed while you were working. Reload the page and try again.

Common.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.
Common.noAccess: You do not have access to this.
Common.notFound: Not found, or it belongs to a branch you cannot see.
Common.conflict: This record is not in the right state for that, or someone changed it. Reload and try again.
Common.reviewWithAssistantHint: The assistant explains why it was refused, and can prepare the entry as a draft if you want.
Common.reviewWithAssistantFailed: Could not open the assistant. Try again.
Common.loadTypeFollows: Follows the cargo type: FCL for a container, LCL otherwise. Pick one to keep it.

Customers.title: Customers
Customers.search: Search by name, number or phone
Customers.name: Name
Customers.partiesHint: Parties are kept separately from the customer and chosen on each booking.

Rates.title: Rates
Rates.workflow: Sales add rates as drafts. A Branch Manager approves them. Only approved rates can be used in quotations; an approved rate is never edited, only cancelled and replaced.

RateCosts.title: Reference costs and expected margin
RateCosts.planningOnly: A planning estimate from reference costs, not the actual profit: actual profit comes from the posted books.
RateCosts.unitsPer: {count} card units in one cost unit
RateCosts.needsConversion: Not in the card's unit: enter how many card units one cost unit holds.

Quotations.title: Quotations
Quotations.noRates: No approved rates for this route, mode and currency in the customer’s branch. Use manual lines or add a rate.
Quotations.totalsHint: Totals are calculated by the system when you save.
Quotations.sectionCustomerHint: Search by name, number or phone.
Quotations.sectionPricingHint: The quotation currency and how long the offer stays valid.
Quotations.fromRate: Charge, unit and price come from the selected rate.
Quotations.sent: Marked as sent to the customer.
Quotations.approvedNotice: Recorded as approved by the customer.
Quotations.currencySuggestionNotApplied: The suggested currency for this customer is {currency}. It was not applied because the lines already hold prices; change the currency yourself if needed.

Bookings.title: Bookings
Bookings.cbmHint: Enter length, width and height in cm and the system calculates CBM; or enter CBM directly.
Bookings.sectionCustomerHint: Search by name, number or phone.
Bookings.sectionRouteHint: Where the cargo goes, how, and when the customer wants it to leave.
Bookings.sectionPartiesHint: Shipper, consignee and notify party, from the customer's list.
Bookings.servicesHint: What NOLON handles on this booking.
Bookings.noItems: No cargo lines yet. Add at least one before confirming.
Bookings.addToContainerHint: The booking leaves from the container's port of loading, sea LCL. Saving confirms it, creates its shipment and puts it in the container.
Bookings.pickCustomerToSave: Choose the customer at the top of the form to save.
Bookings.fromQuotationHint: Filled in from the quotation. Review it and save: nothing is created until you save. The route, mode and cargo stay the quotation's.
Bookings.itemsFromQuotation: Container lines come from the quotation's per-container charges. Check them before saving.
Bookings.partiesFromLastBooking: Suggested from the customer's last booking, {number}. Change them if needed.
Bookings.partiesFromOnlyParty: Suggested: the customer's only party, as consignee. Change it if needed.

Shipments.title: Shipments
Shipments.empty: No shipments yet. A shipment is created when its booking is confirmed.
Shipments.occurredAtHint: Leave the time empty to record it as now. It cannot be before {earliest} (the shipment's last status) or in the future.
Shipments.revertedNotice: Went back to the previous status.
Shipments.trackingHint: Send the link to the customer or print the QR code on documents. The page shows no names or amounts.
Shipments.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
Shipments.fileRejected: Only PDF, JPEG, PNG and WebP files are accepted.
Shipments.sharedBranchesHint: Users of these branches see the shipment and record its receipt, customs, trips and delivery. Invoicing stays with this branch.
Shipments.inConsolidation: This shipment travels in consolidated container {number}: its container is the consolidation’s, shown here read-only.
Shipments.containerTypeFromBooking: From the booking lines, which have this one container type.
Shipments.locationNotUsual: {status} usually happens at {usual}. Check that this is the right shipment and place before saving.
Shipments.reasonTooShort: Write a reason of at least {min} letters.
Shipments.revertUndoes: This undoes «{status}», recorded by {user} on {time}, and goes back to «{to}».
Shipments.revertOthersStep: This step was recorded by {user}, not by you. Undo it only if you are sure it is wrong.
Shipments.revertConfirmOthers: I checked: this step is wrong and should be undone.
Shipments.revertTargetChanged: The step to undo has changed since this form opened. Close it and open “Go back a status” again to review the step shown now.
Shipments.containerMoveWarning: This shipment is in container {container}. «{status}» is normally recorded by moving the container, which moves all its shipments. Record it here only if this shipment alone is different.
Shipments.closeGoodsOnHand: This shipment's goods are still in the warehouse: {warehouses}. Release them first, then close the shipment.
Shipments.closeNotInvoiced: No approved invoice bills this shipment. Approve its invoice first, or write why it is closed without charges.
Shipments.closeCostsReminder: Before closing, check that all the shipment's costs are recorded: supplier bills, trips and container costs.

Track.notFound: We could not find a shipment for this link. Check the link or search by shipment number.
Track.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
Track.lookupHint: Enter the shipment number and the last 4 digits of the phone number we have on file.
Track.noMatch: No shipment matches this number and phone.

Invoices.title: Customer invoices
Invoices.createHint: An invoice is started from its shipment's page.
Invoices.approveConfirm: Approving gives the invoice its number and posts it to the ledger. It can no longer be edited, only cancelled.
Invoices.cancelApprovedHint: Cancelling an approved invoice posts a reversing journal entry.
Invoices.fxRateHint: The rate is units of {currency} per 1 USD. Leave it empty to use the rate table's rate for the invoice date.
Invoices.repriceHint: The prices were in {from}, so they were cleared: enter every price in {to}.
Invoices.totalsHint: Line totals and the invoice total are calculated when you save.
Invoices.notEditable: Only a draft invoice can be edited.
Invoices.noneForShipment: No invoices for this shipment yet.
Invoices.otherInvoicesWarning: This shipment already has {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} that {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not cancelled. Another invoice bills it again: check {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.
Invoices.otherInvoicesConfirm: I checked these invoices; add another invoice to the shipment.
Invoices.creditNoteHint: A credit note reduces what this invoice still owes, up to its open amount. It is approved separately, which posts the reversing entry.

Receipts.title: Receipts
Receipts.fxRateHint: The rate is units of {currency} per 1 USD. Leave it empty to use the rate table's rate for the receipt date.
Receipts.cashAccountsNoAccess: You cannot view the chart of accounts, so the cash and bank accounts cannot be listed. Ask a finance manager or an administrator.
Receipts.noCashAccounts: No active cash or bank account holds {currency} for this branch.
Receipts.allocationsHint: Enter the amount for each invoice in the receipt currency. Whatever is not allocated is held as a customer advance.
Receipts.sectionCustomerHint: Search by name, number or phone.
Receipts.pickCustomerFirst: Choose the customer to see their open invoices.
Receipts.noOpenInvoices: This customer has no open invoices.
Receipts.cancelHint: Cancelling posts a reversing journal entry and reopens the invoices it paid.
Receipts.currencyFromInvoices: The customer's open invoices are all in {currency}.
Receipts.currencySuggestionNotApplied: The customer's open invoices are all in {currency}. It was not applied because the amount was entered in another currency; change the currency yourself if needed.
Receipts.invoicesChanged: The customer's open invoices changed since this form was opened. Reload the page, then allocate the amount.
Receipts.mixedCurrencies: The open invoices are in several currencies: choose the receipt's currency.
Receipts.distribute: Allocate the amount, oldest invoice first
Receipts.distributedRest: {amount} {currency} is left over and will be held as an advance.
Receipts.applyHint: {amount} {currency} of this receipt is held as an advance. Choose an open invoice of the same customer, branch and currency, and the amount to apply. A journal entry moves it from the advance to the invoice.
Receipts.noApplicableInvoices: The customer has no open invoice in this currency and branch.
Receipts.noApplications: The advance has not been applied to any invoice.
Receipts.reverseApplicationHint: Reversing posts a reversing journal entry, returns the amount to the advance and reopens the invoice by it. The original entry is kept.
Receipts.cancelNeedsReversal: Part of this receipt's advance is applied to later invoices. To cancel the receipt, reverse those applications first.

Journals.title: Journal entries
Journals.postConfirm: Posting checks that the entry balances and makes it final: a posted entry cannot be edited or deleted, only reversed.
Journals.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft entry? This cannot be undone.
Journals.reverseHint: A reversing entry with the same lines, debits and credits swapped, is posted. The original entry stays as it is.
Journals.reverseDate: Reversal date (optional, today if empty; must be in an open period)
Journals.linesHint: Enter a debit or a credit on each line, in the line's currency. Leave the rate empty to use the rate table's rate for the entry date. A draft may be unbalanced; it must balance in USD to be posted.
Journals.sectionEntryHint: The branch, the date it is posted on, and what the entry is for.
Journals.notEditable: Only a draft manual entry can be edited.
Journals.accountsNoAccess: You cannot view the chart of accounts, so accounts cannot be chosen.

TrialBalance.title: Trial balance
TrialBalance.hint: Posted entries up to and including the date, in USD.
TrialBalance.empty: No posted entries up to this date.

Accounts.title: Chart of accounts
Accounts.name: Name
Accounts.formHint: A header account groups others and takes no postings. A cash or bank account must have a currency.
Accounts.mappingsHint: Invoices and receipts post to these accounts. Receivable, payable and advances are control accounts: manual entries cannot use them.
Accounts.chargeTypesHint: Leave the account on default to use the default revenue account, or the reimbursable account when the charge is reimbursable.
Accounts.expenseCategoriesHint: Each category posts general expenses and expense lines of supplier bills to its account.

FxRates.title: Exchange rates
FxRates.hint: Each rate is how many units of the currency equal 1 USD on that date. A document uses the latest rate on or before its date.
FxRates.rateLabel: Units of the currency per 1 USD
FxRates.upsertHint: Saving a rate for a currency and date that already has one replaces it.

Periods.title: Accounting periods
Periods.hint: Entries can be posted only in an open period. Closing a period cannot be undone.
Periods.closeWarning: Closing a period cannot be undone: no entry dated in it can be posted afterwards. Confirm on the row.

Warehouse.title: Warehouses
Warehouse.hint: Warehouses of your branches and their storage locations. Deactivate a warehouse or location instead of deleting it.
Warehouse.noWarehouses: No active warehouse in your branches. Add one on the Warehouses page.
Warehouse.expectedHeld: Packages on the cargo lines: {packages} · held now: {held} · still to receive: {remaining}
Warehouse.extraPackagesConfirmed: More than {remaining} packages: I confirm the extra packages (say why in the note)
Warehouse.photosHint: Add photos to the receipt from the movement log once it is saved.
Warehouse.releaseHint: At most what the warehouse holds for this shipment can be released.
Warehouse.noMovements: No goods received or released yet.
Warehouse.receivedMovedNotice: Goods received: {number}. The shipment is now: {status}.
Warehouse.photoRejected: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP photos are accepted.
Warehouse.remainingSuggested: The packages still to receive. Count them and confirm.
Warehouse.weightHeldSuggested: Suggested: the weight still held in this warehouse, for releasing all of it.
Warehouse.placeHint: A goods receipt that moves the shipment shows it at this place on the tracking page.
Warehouse.cancelMovementHint: The movement stays in the log marked cancelled and counts in no balance. If it moved the shipment's status, the status goes back.

Customs.clearedHint: A cleared file needs its clearance date, which cannot be before the submission date.
Customs.movesShipmentHint: Saving a file in progress moves the shipment to customs in progress; saving a cleared file moves it to cleared on the clearance date, when the shipment can take that step.
Customs.documentsHint: Customs papers go in the shipment documents below.
Customs.feesHint: Fees are recorded with their currency only. They reach the accounts with the supplier bills.
Customs.brokerHint: Choose the broker from the suppliers to show its bills here. Leave the broker name empty to use the supplier's name.
Customs.noSupplierCosts: No supplier bills for this shipment's customs.
Customs.supplierCostsHint: Lines of supplier bills for this shipment that are customs charges or from the file's broker. They are the bills' own costs, shown here only: they are not added to the fees above, and nothing is posted from this page. Totals count approved bills; cancelled bills are left out.

Transport.tripsHint: Road legs of your branches: own vehicles and hired carriers. A driver sees the trips assigned to them.
Transport.newTripHint: Pick the route, the vehicle and driver (or a carrier), and the shipments it carries.
Transport.fleetMissing: This branch has no active vehicle or driver yet. Add them on the Vehicles and Drivers pages.
Transport.scheduleHint: Creating the trip moves its shipments to Trip scheduled. A shipment that cannot take that step now stops the whole trip.
Transport.moveHint: Departing and arriving move every shipment on the trip. If one of them cannot move, nothing changes.
Transport.moveRefused: A shipment on this trip cannot take this step now (on hold, cancelled or at another stage). Check the shipments below, or take it off the trip while it is planned.
Transport.cancelledNotice: The trip is cancelled. Its shipments can go on another trip.
Transport.podNotNow: This shipment cannot take a proof of delivery now.
Transport.expensesHint: Paid from a cash or bank account and posted at once; shared between the shipments by CBM, else weight, else equally.
Transport.noCashAccounts: No active cash or bank account for this branch.
Transport.expenseCancelled: Expense cancelled; its reversing entry is posted.
Transport.accrualHint: The agreed cost is accrued to the shipments when the trip is completed; the carrier's bill settles it later.
Transport.accrualPending: Accrued when the trip is completed.
Transport.noShipmentTrips: This shipment is on no trip.
Transport.vehiclesHint: Owned vehicles of your branches. Deactivate a vehicle instead of deleting it.
Transport.driversHint: Link a driver to a user with the Driver role: that user then sees their own trips, also on a phone.
Transport.name: Name
Transport.carriersHint: External transport companies, shared by every branch.
Transport.signHint: Ask the recipient to sign in the box.
Transport.photoTooLarge: A photo is larger than 10 MB.
Transport.podRejected: The details, the signature or a photo were not accepted. Check them and try again.
Transport.podSavedMoved: POD {number} saved; the shipment is now: {status}.
Transport.arrivedAndCompletedNotice: The trip arrived and is completed.
Transport.arrivedNotCompleted: The arrival is recorded, but the trip could not be completed: {reason} Use “Complete trip” to finish it.
Transport.originFromShipment: Suggested: where the shipment is now. Check where the trip starts.
Transport.vehicleFromLastTrip: Suggested: the vehicle of this driver's last trip ({trip}).
Transport.supplierCreated: Supplier created from the carrier and linked.
Transport.supplierExists: A supplier with the same name or phone already exists. Link the carrier to it instead of creating another:
Transport.carrierNotLinked: The carrier is added but not linked to the supplier: {reason}
Transport.nameFromUser: Filled from the linked user's name. You can change it.
Transport.cancelPodHint: The proof of delivery stays, with its signature and photos, marked cancelled. If it moved the shipment's status, the status goes back, and the shipment's place goes back to where it was before.

Consolidations.title: Consolidated containers
Consolidations.hint: LCL shipments of different customers in one sea container. Moving the container moves its shipments; closing it shares its costs by CBM or weight.
Consolidations.newHint: Port to port. Add LCL sea shipments now or later, while the container is open.
Consolidations.pickHint: Only LCL sea shipments not yet loaded are offered.
Consolidations.moveHint_CLOSED: Closing fixes the shipments and their CBM or weight, marks them consolidated and shares the approved container costs between them.
Consolidations.moveHint_LOADED: Every shipment in the container becomes loaded.
Consolidations.moveHint_DEPARTED: Every shipment in the container becomes departed.
Consolidations.moveHint_ARRIVED: Every shipment in the container arrives at the port of discharge.
Consolidations.moveHint_DECONSOLIDATED: Each shipment then continues on its own from the port.
Consolidations.shipmentsHint: The basis value is the CBM or weight fixed when the container was closed.
Consolidations.costsHint: Approved supplier bill lines charging this container. Each is shared between the shipments once the container is closed.
Consolidations.clearingBalance: Left on the consolidation clearing account
Consolidations.notConsolidated: This shipment is not in a consolidated container.
Consolidations.newBooking: New LCL booking in this container
Consolidations.guestHint: This is a {branch} container. You see your own shipments only; only its branch takes shipments out or moves them.
Consolidations.moveNone: No other open container in your branches.
Consolidations.capacityHint: CBM and weight of the cargo in it against the limits of its container type. A shipment that would take it over a limit is refused.
Consolidations.capacityAsOfNow: The cargo in it now against the current limits of its container type.
Consolidations.capacityNoLimit: {used} {unit} (no limit set for this container type)
Consolidations.capacityNotChecked: Not checked in full: some cargo has no such measure yet.
Consolidations.capacityIncomplete: Cargo without CBM or weight (enter it before closing):

Alerts.title: Alerts
Alerts.hint: What waits on you in your branches: shipments arriving soon, shipments past their ETA, overdue invoices, stalled customs files, goods stored too long and late trips.
Alerts.settingsHint: The alerts are fixed. You set only how many days each waits before it shows (for shipments arriving soon: how many days before the ETA).
Alerts.noneForRole: None of the alerts concerns your role.
Alerts.rule_SHIPMENT_ARRIVING_SOON: Still on the way, with the ETA {days, plural, =0 {today} one {within # day} other {within # days}}.
Alerts.rule_SHIPMENT_PAST_ETA: Not delivered more than {days, plural, =0 {0 days} one {# day} other {# days}} after the ETA.
Alerts.rule_INVOICE_OVERDUE: Not fully paid more than {days, plural, =0 {0 days} one {# day} other {# days}} after the due date.
Alerts.rule_CUSTOMS_STALLED: Not cleared and not updated for more than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
Alerts.rule_STORAGE_EXCEEDED: In the warehouse for more than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
Alerts.rule_TRIP_LATE: Not arrived {days, plural, =0 {after the planned arrival} one {# day after the planned arrival} other {# days after the planned arrival}}.

ApiAccess.title: API access
ApiAccess.hint: Two separate kinds of access, each in its own section: keys for the Customer Service API, and the assistant platforms that sign staff in. A key does not sign anyone in, and an assistant uses no key.

ApiKeys.title: Customer Service API keys
ApiKeys.hint: In use now: a key lets a customer-service client (such as a WhatsApp agent) call the Customer Service API (/cs/…) for the customers of its branches, with customer-safe fields only. A key does only what its scopes allow, and no scope is given by default.
ApiKeys.name: Name
ApiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Clients using it stop working at once.
ApiKeys.createdHint: This is the only time it is shown. Keep it in the client's secret settings, never in code or chat.
ApiKeys.scopesHint: Give a customer-facing bot only what it needs. «Read customers» reads every customer of the key's branches: never give it to a bot that serves one customer at a time.
ApiKeys.scope_customers_read: Read customers, shipments and invoices by number
ApiKeys.scope_tracking_lookup: Track by shipment number and phone

Reports.title: Financial reports
Reports.intro: Posted entries only, in your branches, in USD unless a column names another currency. Each report exports to Excel.
Reports.chooseAccounts: Choose one or more accounts, then Show.
Reports.trialBalanceHint: Debits, credits and balance of every account as of a date.
Reports.incomeStatementHint: Revenue and expenses of the period, per account and branch.
Reports.balanceSheetHint: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a date, with the profit not yet closed.
Reports.generalLedgerHint: Opening balance, posted lines and running balance of one or more accounts.
Reports.arAgingHint: What approved invoices still owe as of a date, by days past due.
Reports.profitabilityHint: Actual revenue, cost and margin from the posted books, per shipment, customer, route, sales outlet, origin country and category.
Reports.invoicesReceiptsHint: Approved invoices and receipts dated in the period.
Reports.cashMovementHint: Money in and out of each cash and bank account, and realized exchange differences.
Reports.openAccrualsHint: Completed carrier trips not yet billed, and the consolidated container clearing balance.
Reports.notBalanced: Assets do not equal liabilities plus equity: check the entries of these branches.
Reports.noFx: No exchange differences in the period.
Reports.otherAccrued: Of which not from a trip
Reports.generalLedgerOpeningNote: Opening balances of revenue and expense accounts are cumulative from the first entry: closing a period does not post closing entries, so the year's profit is not moved to equity.
Reports.apAgingHint: What approved supplier bills still owe as of a date, by days past due.
Reports.includesNotFinal: Includes {count} shipments whose figures are not final yet (a booked service without its cost, an open transport accrual, or not closed).
Reports.categoryHint: Each shipment counts whole in one column: its one category, Mixed when its lines have more than one, Unspecified when a line has none. Margin per unit only when every shipment has its units.

OpsReports.title: Operational reports
OpsReports.intro: Shipments, sales, warehouse, customs and transport, in your branches. Each report can be exported to Excel.
OpsReports.shipments: Shipments by status, branch, route and mode
OpsReports.shipmentsHint: Shipments created in the period, counted by status, branch, route and mode.
OpsReports.lateHint: Shipments with an ETA in the period that were delivered after it, or are still not delivered.
OpsReports.conversionHint: Quotations sent and bookings created in the period, with the approval, conversion and confirmation rates.
OpsReports.activityHint: Shipments, volume, weight and approved invoice revenue per customer in the period.
OpsReports.containersHint: Consolidated containers with the shipments and customers in each.
OpsReports.containersNote: A container is in the period by its ETD, else by the day it was opened. Weight and volume are the booked cargo lines; costs are on each container's page, for those who may see them.
OpsReports.onHandHint: What each warehouse holds now for each shipment, and for how many days.
OpsReports.movementsHint: Goods received and released in the period.
OpsReports.customsHint: Customs files by status, with the clearance time.
OpsReports.trips: Trips by vehicle, driver and carrier
OpsReports.tripsHint: Trips of the period with their cost from posted expenses and accruals.
OpsReports.noneLate: No late shipments for these filters.
OpsReports.truncated: Only the first rows are listed. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
OpsReports.withEta: With an ETA in the period
OpsReports.conversionNote: Approval rate: approved of sent. Conversion rate: sent quotations that became a booking (not cancelled). Confirmation rate: bookings confirmed or completed of those created.
OpsReports.revenueNote: Shipments created in the period, not cancelled. Revenue: approved invoices dated in the period, in USD.
OpsReports.customsNote: A file is in the period by its submission date, or by the day it was opened while not submitted. Clearance time runs from submission to clearance.
OpsReports.name: Name
OpsReports.tripCostNote: Cost in USD: posted trip expenses and the accrual of a completed external trip, less cancellations. Hired trucks and drivers show on the trip as written; the groups list own vehicles and drivers.
OpsReports.auditNote: Rates, customers and user accounts are logged field by field, before and after, in an append-only audit table. The rest comes from the records that keep who did what (shipment events, warehouse movements, customs files and fees, journal entries, invoices, receipts, credit notes, supplier bills and payments, general expenses, trips, trip expenses, proofs of delivery and documents). A customs file keeps only its last update. User accounts appear only to those who manage users, with all branches selected.
OpsReports.warehouseScope: Figures cover your branches' shipments, in whichever warehouse they are held.

Dashboards.managementHint: Shipments, results per branch, overdue receivables and top customers in the period.
Dashboards.branchHint: Your branch's figures, with today's shipments, the warehouse and the trips on the road.
Dashboards.noRevenue: No approved invoices in the period.

Print.pdfHint: To save a PDF, choose “Save as PDF” as the printer.
Print.qrAlt: QR code of the shipment's public tracking page
Print.notFound: Not found, or it belongs to a branch you cannot see.
Print.bookingNote: We confirm your booking on the terms above. Please quote the booking number in all correspondence.
Print.labelsCount: {count, plural, one {# label} other {# labels}} of {total} packages
Print.labelsTruncated: Labels are laid out {count} at a time.
Print.noPackages: The cargo lines have no packages to label.
Print.signatureOnFile: Signed on screen; the signature is kept with the shipment's documents.
Print.trackingNote: Scan the QR code to follow the shipment on its public tracking page.
Print.statementEmpty: No posted invoices or receipts for this customer up to this date.
Print.statementNote: Posted entries only: invoices, receipts and their cancellations, and any other posted entry on the customer's account. Amounts are in each currency; a negative balance is a credit (an advance) in the customer's favour.

CreditNotes.title: Credit notes
CreditNotes.intro: Credit notes are created from an approved invoice. Approving one posts the reversing entry.
CreditNotes.approveConfirm: Approving numbers the credit note and posts the reversing entry. It cannot be edited afterwards.

Suppliers.title: Suppliers
Suppliers.name: Name
Suppliers.carriersHint: This supplier's bills settle the trips of these carriers: a bill for a completed trip clears its accrued cost.

Partners.title: Partners
Partners.hint: Sales outlets, origin consolidators, overseas agents and distributors in Sudan, in any country. Commissions and settlements are set up later.
Partners.name: Name
Partners.commissionsLater: Partner settlements and payments come in a later step.
Partners.noPlacesInCountry: No city or port of this country is recorded yet.

PartnerContracts.title: Commission contracts
PartnerContracts.settingsOnly: Settings only: a contract sets the commission shown in a rate card's expected margin. Nothing is accrued, posted or settled from it yet.

SupplierBills.title: Supplier bills
SupplierBills.openingHint: Open at go-live; posted against opening equity.
SupplierBills.linesHint: A shipment cost goes to the charge's cost account; a carrier trip clears that trip's accrued cost; a general expense goes to its category's account.
SupplierBills.approveConfirm: Approving numbers the bill and posts it to the payable. It cannot be edited afterwards.
SupplierBills.cancelApprovedHint: Cancelling an approved bill posts a reversing entry dated today; its trips can be billed again.
SupplierBills.dueDateFromTerms: Left empty, it is the bill date plus the supplier's {days} days of payment terms.
SupplierBills.dueDateFromTermsUnknown: Left empty, it is the bill date plus the supplier's payment terms.
SupplierBills.tripsInOtherCurrencies: This supplier's trips to bill are also in:
SupplierBills.noShipments: No shipment of this branch matches.
SupplierBills.duplicateWarning: Supplier reference {reference} is on {count, plural, one {# other supplier bill} other {# other supplier bills}} in this branch that {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not cancelled. The same supplier invoice may be entered twice: check {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.
SupplierBills.duplicateConfirm: I checked these bills; this is a different supplier invoice.

SupplierPayments.title: Supplier payments
SupplierPayments.fxRateHint: The rate is units of {currency} per 1 USD. Leave it empty to use the rate table's rate for the payment date.
SupplierPayments.cashAccountsNoAccess: You cannot view the chart of accounts, so the cash and bank accounts cannot be listed.
SupplierPayments.allocationsHint: Enter the amount paid on each bill in the payment currency. The payment is the sum of these amounts.
SupplierPayments.pickSupplierFirst: Choose the supplier to see their open bills.
SupplierPayments.noOpenBills: This supplier has no open bills in this branch.
SupplierPayments.cancelHint: Cancelling posts a reversing journal entry and reopens the bills it paid.

Expenses.title: Expenses
Expenses.intro: General expenses paid from cash or bank (rent, utilities, office...). Trip costs are entered on the trip.
Expenses.cashAccountsNoAccess: You cannot view the chart of accounts, so the cash and bank accounts cannot be listed.
Expenses.approveConfirm: Approving numbers the expense and posts it. It cannot be edited afterwards.
Expenses.cancelApprovedHint: Cancelling an approved expense posts a reversing entry dated today.

OpeningBalances.title: Opening balances
OpeningBalances.intro: Enter the balances at go-live once: ledger accounts, then each customer's and supplier's open invoices. Everything posts against the opening equity account.
OpeningBalances.accountsHint: Cash, bank, assets and other balances in one entry. Receivables and payables come from the open items below.
OpeningBalances.customerHint: Each invoice still open at go-live, with its number in the previous system.
OpeningBalances.supplierHint: Each supplier bill still open at go-live, with the supplier's number.

Import.intro_customers: Each row becomes a new customer in one of your branches. Existing customers are never changed.
Import.intro_rates: Each row becomes a new draft rate in one of your branches, to be approved as usual before quotations use it.
Import.step1: Download the template. Its Lists sheet holds the codes you can use (branches, currencies and more), and the Instructions sheet explains every column.
Import.step2: Fill the first sheet, one record per row, up to {rows} rows. Type values only: no formulas.
Import.step3: Upload the file to check it. Nothing is saved until every row is correct and you confirm; then all rows are saved together.
Import.summary: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}: {valid} correct, {invalid} with errors.
Import.fixAndUpload: Nothing can be imported until every row is correct: fix the file and upload it again.
Import.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
Import.imported_customers: {count, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}} imported.
Import.imported_rates: {count, plural, one {# draft rate} other {# draft rates}} imported.
Import.alreadyImported: This file was already imported ({count} records); nothing was added again.
Import.changedSincePreview: The data changed since the check, so nothing was imported. The errors are listed below.
Import.fileErr_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
Import.fileErr_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read as an Excel workbook.
Import.fileErr_MISSING_COLUMNS: Required columns are missing from the first row:
Import.fileErr_UNKNOWN_COLUMNS: These columns are not in the template; remove or rename them:
Import.fileErr_NO_ROWS: The file has no data rows under the headers.
Import.fileErr_TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than {rows} rows; split it into smaller files.
Import.err_INVALID_VALUE: Not an allowed value (see the Lists sheet).
Import.err_INVALID_AMOUNT: Invalid amount: digits and an optional decimal point, no separators.
Import.err_AMOUNT_NOT_EXACT: Too many decimal places (at most 4); nothing is rounded.
Import.err_FORMULA_NOT_ALLOWED: Formulas are not accepted; paste values only.
Import.err_CREDIT_LIMIT_PAIR: Credit limit and its currency go together.
Import.err_UNKNOWN_LOCATION: Unknown or inactive port or city code.
Import.err_LOAD_TYPE_SEA_ONLY: FCL/LCL applies to sea rates only.
Import.err_CONTAINER_TYPE_REQUIRED: A container rate needs a container type.
Import.err_CONTAINER_TYPE_NOT_APPLICABLE: Container type applies to container cargo only.

AgentAuthorize.title: Signing in to the assistant
AgentAuthorize.connecting: Connecting your NOLON account to the assistant…
AgentAuthorize.failed: The assistant could not be connected.

AgentClients.title: Staff assistant sign-in (delegated)
AgentClients.hint: A registered assistant platform can sign staff in with NOLON. It then reads, as that staff member, only the screens opened to it, with their own permissions and branches, for 10 minutes at a time. It cannot change anything. Revoking it ends every assistant sign-in at once.
AgentClients.revokeConfirm: Revoke this assistant? Every staff sign-in through it ends at once.

GrnDrafts.title: Drafts from the assistant
GrnDrafts.hint: The assistant read the shipment's packing list and proposed these goods receipts. Nothing is recorded until a person checks a draft against its file and approves it.
GrnDrafts.sourceGone: The source packing list was deleted. This draft can no longer be approved.
GrnDrafts.sheetTruncated: Only the first rows and columns are shown. Download the file to see all of it.
GrnDrafts.legendMatched: Filled by the assistant and found in the file at that place (the column or unit was not checked)
GrnDrafts.legendUnverified: Filled by the assistant, not checked against the file
GrnDrafts.legendMismatch: Filled by the assistant, not found in the file: check it
GrnDrafts.legendStaff: Typed or changed by a person
GrnDrafts.saveBeforeDeciding: Save your changes before approving or rejecting.
GrnDrafts.approveHint: The warehouse, packages, weight and condition are yours to confirm: they become the goods receipt.
GrnDrafts.extraPackagesConfirmed: Confirm extra packages beyond the cargo lines (say why in the note)
GrnDrafts.warning_TOTAL_PACKAGES_MISMATCH: The lines do not add up to the packages total on the document.
GrnDrafts.warning_TOTAL_GROSS_MISMATCH: The lines do not add up to the gross weight on the document.
GrnDrafts.warning_TOTAL_NET_MISMATCH: The lines do not add up to the net weight on the document.
GrnDrafts.warning_TOTAL_CBM_MISMATCH: The lines do not add up to the volume on the document.
GrnDrafts.warning_SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIABLE: The file is a scan or photo: no value could be checked against it.
GrnDrafts.warning_NET_ABOVE_GROSS: A line has a net weight above its gross weight.
GrnDrafts.proposalHint: Kept as the assistant proposed it, whatever is edited above.

Drafts.title: Drafts from the assistant
Drafts.hint: Entries the assistant proposed for staff. Nothing is recorded until a person opens a draft and approves it; approving runs NOLON's own checks with your permissions.
Drafts.replacesEarlier: This draft replaces an earlier one, at your request to the assistant.
Drafts.replacedBy: Replaced at your request to the assistant by a newer draft:
Drafts.customerApproveHint: Approving adds this customer to the branch now, if no customer of the branch has this phone. Terms, credit and tax details are set on the customer afterwards.
Drafts.partyApproveHint: Approving adds this party to the customer now. A booking can then name it as shipper, consignee or notify party.
Drafts.rateCardApproveHint: Approving adds this rate as a draft rate of the branch now, if the branch has no draft or approved rate for the same offer. It still needs the usual rate approval before a quotation can use it.
Drafts.subject: Subject
Drafts.notRecorded: This is a proposal. Nothing is recorded until it is approved.
Drafts.wordsHint: The assistant took each value below from these words. Tick each value that matches what the staff member wrote; The place and transit values share one tick. Approve stays off until every value is ticked.
Drafts.wordsGroup: One tick for these values, each matching its words: {fields}
Drafts.checkOk: NOLON would accept this draft now.
Drafts.checkFailed: NOLON would refuse this draft now: {message}
Drafts.quotationApproveHint: Approving creates a draft quotation priced by NOLON. You can still edit it before sending it to the customer.
Drafts.bookingApproveHint: Approving creates a draft booking. It is not confirmed and has no shipment until you confirm it.
Drafts.tripApproveHint: Approving plans the trip and schedules its shipments, as planning it yourself would. The trip can still be changed or cancelled while it is planned.
Drafts.releaseApproveHint: Approving issues the release note now, dated at the approval, if the warehouse still holds these packages.
Drafts.shipmentStatusApproveHint: Approving moves the shipment to the new status now, dated at the approval, if that move is still allowed from its current status and your role may make it.
Drafts.invoiceApproveHint: Approving creates a draft invoice. Nothing is posted: the invoice is approved, numbered and posted separately, as usual.
Drafts.receiptApproveHint: Approving records the receipt and posts its journal entry, and settles the invoices listed, in your name. Check the amount against the bank or cash first.
Drafts.newCustomerBookingTitle: Booking draft for a new customer: {customer}
Drafts.newCustomerBookingApproveHint: Approving creates a draft booking for the customer approved from the customer draft. It is not confirmed and has no shipment until you confirm it. Add the shipper, consignee and notify party on the booking.
Drafts.newCustomerQuotationTitle: Quotation draft for a new customer: {customer}
Drafts.newCustomerQuotationApproveHint: Approving adds this customer to the branch and creates a draft quotation for them, priced by NOLON, together: if a customer of the branch has this phone by then, nothing is created. You can still edit the quotation before sending it.
Drafts.approveCustomerFirst: Approve the customer first: a booking needs a customer in NOLON. Open the customer draft, check it and approve it, then come back to approve this booking.
Drafts.customerNotApproved: The customer draft was rejected or has expired, so this booking cannot be approved. Reject it, or ask the assistant for a new one.
Drafts.bookingWithCustomer: A booking was proposed with this customer:
Drafts.containerHint: On approval the booking is confirmed and its shipment goes in this container, if it is still open with room.
Drafts.containerBookingApproveHint: Approving creates the booking, confirms it (its shipment is created) and puts the shipment in the container. If the container is no longer open or is full, nothing is created.
Drafts.newCustomerContainerBookingApproveHint: Approving creates the booking for the customer approved from the customer draft, confirms it and puts its shipment in the container. If the container is no longer open or is full, nothing is created. Add the shipper, consignee and notify party on the booking.
Drafts.systemPriceHint: Prices marked “system price” were found by NOLON, not typed: check them before approving.
Drafts.missingHint: The assistant saved this draft without these values. Fill them in and save; NOLON checks each value, and the draft can be approved once nothing is missing.
Drafts.missingReadOnly: This draft cannot be approved until these values are filled in.
Drafts.waitingHint: Open drafts of every type, including goods received drafts, that you can approve or reject now, in your branches. Newest first.
Drafts.missingSuggestedHint: NOLON filled in the values it suggests. Check or change them, then save; nothing is saved until you do.
Drafts.approveWithCustomer: The customer is not approved yet. You can approve the customer and the booking together here: tick the customer’s words and the booking’s, then approve. Or approve the customer draft first on its own screen.
Drafts.newCustomerBookingWithCustomerApproveHin: Approving adds this customer to the branch and creates a draft booking for them, together: if either is refused (for example, a customer of the branch has this phone by then), nothing is created. The booking is not confirmed and has no shipment until you confirm it. Add the shipper, consignee and notify party on the booking.

Refusals.SAME_ROUTE: From and To must be different places.
Refusals.LOAD_TYPE_SEA_ONLY: FCL/LCL applies to sea shipments only.
Refusals.CONTAINER_TYPE_REQUIRED: A container line needs a container type.
Refusals.CONTAINER_TYPE_NOT_APPLICABLE: A container type applies to container lines only.
Refusals.UNKNOWN_CONTAINER_TYPE: This container type is unknown or no longer in use.
Refusals.DIMENSIONS_TOGETHER: Enter length, width and height together, or none of them and the CBM instead.
Refusals.VOLUME_TOO_LARGE: The volume is too large: check the dimensions and the quantity.
Refusals.VALID_UNTIL_PAST: The valid-until date is in the past.
Refusals.CURRENCY_NOT_ACTIVE: This currency is unknown or no longer in use.
Refusals.ROUTE_CODE_MISSING: Place {location} has no letters for route numbers: an administrator sets its short code (Master data, Locations).
Refusals.QUOTED_ROUTE_FIXED: This booking was made from a quotation: its route and mode are the quotation's and cannot change.
Refusals.RATE_NOT_USABLE: This rate does not apply to this quotation (route, mode, load, cargo, currency or date).
Refusals.MANUAL_LINE_INCOMPLETE: A line without a rate needs a charge, a unit and a price.
Refusals.UNKNOWN_CHARGE_TYPE: This charge is unknown or no longer in use.
Refusals.DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_LINE: The discount is larger than the line amount.
Refusals.CONTAINER_BRANCH_ONLY: Container {container} belongs to another branch: only that branch changes it, takes a shipment out or moves one.
Refusals.CONTAINER_NOT_OPEN: Container {container} is no longer open: shipments are no longer added, taken out or moved.
Refusals.CONTAINER_FULL: Container {container} is full: it takes no more shipments.
Refusals.SAME_CONTAINER: The shipment is already in this container: pick another one.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_OTHER_BRANCH: Shipment {shipment} belongs to a branch you do not work in, so you cannot put it in this container.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_NOT_LCL_SEA: Shipment {shipment} is not an LCL sea shipment NOLON carries.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_OTHER_PORT: Container {container} loads at another port than shipment {shipment} leaves from.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_PAST_LOADING: Shipment {shipment} is past consolidation, on hold or cancelled.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_IN_OTHER_CONTAINER: Shipment {shipment} is in container {container}: take it out or move it first.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_HAS_LIVE_INVOICES: Shipment {shipment} still has invoices, so it cannot be cancelled. Cancel its draft invoices ({drafts}) and issue credit notes covering its approved invoices ({approved}) first. A paid or part-paid invoice blocks the cancellation.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_ALREADY_INVOICED: Shipment {shipment} already has invoices (approved: {approved}; drafts: {drafts}), or they changed since you looked. Check them, then confirm to add another invoice.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_ALREADY_INVOICED_REVIEW: Shipment {shipment} already has invoices (approved: {approved}; drafts: {drafts}). Approve this draft on its review screen in NOLON, where they are listed.
Refusals.CONTAINER_BOOKING_NOT_LCL_SEA: Container {container} takes LCL sea bookings only: make it a sea LCL booking.
Refusals.CONTAINER_BOOKING_OTHER_PORT: Container {container} loads at another port: the booking must leave from that port.
Refusals.CONTAINER_BOOKING_NO_MAIN_FREIGHT: A booking in container {container} includes the main freight: add it to the services.
Refusals.RATE_NO_MATCH: No approved rate card matches this line (route, mode, load, cargo, currency, charge, date): enter the price.
Refusals.RATE_SEVERAL: Several approved rate cards match this line: choose the rate card, or enter the price.
Refusals.INVOICE_CURRENCY_REPRICE: The invoice is in {from}: to invoice in {to}, enter every price in {to}.
Refusals.QUOTED_PRICE_OTHER_CURRENCY: The shipment's quotation prices this charge in another currency: invoice in that currency, or enter the price.
Refusals.QUOTED_PRICE_SEVERAL: The shipment's quotation has several lines for this charge: enter the price.
Refusals.PRICE_AS_ONE_UNIT: A minimum or a discount applies to this charge: invoice it as quantity 1, or enter the price.
Refusals.CASH_ACCOUNT_NOT_USABLE: This cash or bank account cannot take this receipt: choose an active account of the customer's branch in the receipt's currency.
Refusals.ALLOCATION_OTHER_CUSTOMER: This invoice is not one of this customer's invoices.
Refusals.ALLOCATION_NOT_APPROVED: Invoice {invoice} is not approved: only approved invoices take a payment.
Refusals.ALLOCATION_OTHER_CURRENCY: Invoice {invoice} is in {currency}: receive it in that currency.
Refusals.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: Invoice {invoice} has {balance} {currency} left: allocate no more than that.
Refusals.BRANCH_REQUIRED: Choose the branch of this draft.
Refusals.BRANCH_MISMATCH: This branch is not the branch of the customer or shipment: the draft belongs to theirs.
Refusals.CITY_OTHER_COUNTRY: The city {city} is in {country}: the place must be in the same country.
Refusals.MASTER_CODE_TAKEN: The code {code} is already in use: choose another code.
Refusals.BASE_CURRENCY_STAYS_ACTIVE: {code} is the base currency every journal entry balances in: it cannot be deactivated.
Refusals.PARTNER_LOCATION_OTHER_COUNTRY: The location {location} is in {country}: choose a place in the partner's country, or change the country.
Refusals.PARTNER_NOT_USABLE: This partner is unknown, no longer active, or not one of this record's branches.
Refusals.QUOTED_OUTLET_FIXED: A booking made from a quotation keeps the quotation's sales outlet.
Refusals.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_NOT_USABLE: This customer segment is unknown or no longer in use.
Refusals.CONTRACT_OVERLAP: Another approved contract of this partner covers the same category for some of these dates. Cancel it first, or change the dates.
Refusals.CONTRACT_PARTNER_INACTIVE: This partner is no longer active, so its contract cannot be approved.
Refusals.OUTLET_NOT_USABLE: Choose an active sales outlet of your branches.
Refusals.STATUS_TIME_TOO_EARLY: The time cannot be before the shipment was created or its last status.
Refusals.REVERT_STALE: The shipment changed since you opened it. Check its status history and try again.
Refusals.REVERT_CLOSED_CONTAINER: The shipment is in closed container {container}: closing a container is final, so its consolidation cannot be undone.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_CANCEL_ON_TRIP: Shipment {shipment} is on trip {trip}, which has left: it cannot be cancelled from here. Complete the trip, or ask a manager for a correction.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_CANCEL_IN_CONTAINER: Shipment {shipment} is in container {container}, which is closed: it cannot be cancelled from here. Unpack the container at its destination, or ask a manager for a correction.
Refusals.REVERT_BY_TRIP: Trip {record} recorded this step: it cannot be undone from here. Ask a manager for a correction.
Refusals.REVERT_BY_CONTAINER: Container {record} recorded this step: it cannot be undone from here. Ask a manager for a correction.
Refusals.REVERT_BY_WAREHOUSE: Warehouse movement {record} recorded this step: it cannot be undone from here. Cancel the movement on the Warehouse tab (with the permission to cancel warehouse movements).
Refusals.REVERT_BY_POD: Proof of delivery {record} recorded this step: it cannot be undone from here. Cancel the proof of delivery in the Proofs of delivery section (with the permission to cancel them).
Refusals.REVERT_BY_CUSTOMS: The customs file ({record}) recorded this step: it cannot be undone from here. Ask a manager for a correction.
Refusals.SUPPLIER_REFERENCE_DUPLICATE: Supplier reference {reference} is on other bills (approved: {approved}; drafts: {drafts}), or they changed since you looked. Check them, then confirm this is a different invoice.
Refusals.RATE_SUPERSEDED: A narrower rate card prices this route (city before country, place before city): choose it.
Refusals.RATE_CATEGORY_REQUIRED: This rate card prices a category: choose the line's price category first.
Refusals.PRICE_CATEGORY_NOT_USABLE: This price category is unknown, no longer in use, or for another cargo type.
Refusals.COUNTRY_KIND_FIXED: A country pricing scope keeps its kind and country: add a new location instead.
Refusals.COUNTRY_SCOPE_TAKEN: {code} is already the pricing scope of {country}.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_CLOSE_GOODS_ON_HAND: Shipment {shipment} still has goods in the warehouse: {warehouses}. Release them before closing it.
Refusals.SHIPMENT_CLOSE_NOT_INVOICED: No approved invoice bills shipment {shipment} (draft invoices: {drafts}). Approve its invoice, or write why it closes without charges.
Refusals.CONTAINER_OVER_VOLUME: Container {container} has no room for this volume: it holds {limit} CBM, has {used} and would have {after}.
Refusals.CONTAINER_OVER_WEIGHT: Container {container} has no room for this weight: it takes {limit} kg, has {used} and would have {after}.
Refusals.CONTAINER_VOLUME_MISSING: Enter the volume (CBM) of every cargo line before closing or loading container {container}: {shipments}.
Refusals.CONTAINER_WEIGHT_MISSING: Enter the weight of every cargo line before closing or loading container {container}: {shipments}.
Refusals.CORRECTION_ALREADY_DONE: {record} was already cancelled for another reason.
Refusals.MOVEMENT_CANCEL_NEGATIVE: Without movement {movement}, warehouse {warehouse} would release goods it did not hold: cancel the later release first.
Refusals.MOVEMENT_CANCEL_OVER_PACKAGES: Without movement {movement}, the warehouses together would hold {peak} packages of {packages}: cancel the later receipt first.
Refusals.MOVEMENT_CANCEL_STATUS_MOVED: The shipment moved on from the status movement {movement} recorded: undo the later steps first.
Refusals.MOVEMENT_CANCEL_CLOSED: The shipment is closed: movement {movement} cannot be cancelled.
Refusals.POD_CANCEL_LATER_POD: Proof of delivery {later} came after {pod}: cancel it first.
Refusals.POD_CANCEL_STATUS_MOVED: The shipment moved on since proof of delivery {pod}: undo the later steps first.
Refusals.POD_CANCEL_CLOSED: The shipment is closed: proof of delivery {pod} cannot be cancelled.

Locations.title: Ports and cities
Locations.hint: Ports, cities and border points. Link each port to the city it serves, so a search by the city also finds its ports. Deactivate a place instead of deleting it.
Locations.name: Name
Locations.countryFromCity: The city's country: a place is in the country of its city.
Locations.shortCodeHint: Letters in route numbers (DXB in DXB-KRT-0001), 2 to 4. Empty: the city's, else the last three letters of the code.
Locations.aliasesHint: Names people write for this place, separated by commas (for example «Jeddah, Jedda»). The customer-service bot uses them to understand customers.
Locations.routingHint: Branches that take customer-service bot requests starting here (here, else the city's, else the country's). One branch: the request goes to it; several or none: staff route it.

MasterData.title: Master data
MasterData.hint: Container types, charge types, document types, currencies, price categories and customer segments. Deactivate an entry instead of deleting it: records that already use it keep it, and new ones cannot choose it until it is reactivated.
MasterData.codeFixed: The code cannot be changed after it is saved.
MasterData.name: Name
MasterData.decimalPlacesFixed: Amounts are rounded to these places; they cannot be changed after the currency is saved.
MasterData.cargoTypeFixed: The cargo type cannot be changed after it is saved.
MasterData.capacityHint: The values given at first are defaults: set the real limits you load to. Empty means no limit.

Access.title: Permissions
Access.readOnly: You can view the permissions but not change them.
Access.error_stale: Permissions changed while you were working. Reload and try again.
Access.error_conflict: This conflicts with what already exists (a team code in use, or a live delegation for this person in this branch).
Access.error_noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
Access.error_invalid: Check what you entered and try again.
Access.teamsHint: Each column is a team, each row a module. Click a team or a cell to see and change its five actions.
Access.legend: F full · A view and approve · E view, create and edit · V view only · — none · * another mix. A highlighted cell differs from the default.
Access.restrictedTeam: This team is given through the role only and cannot be widened, so it is shown read only.
Access.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? Its members stop getting its permissions. The team is kept, not deleted.
Access.codeHint: Upper case letters, digits and _ only, for example SALES_SUPPORT.
Access.blockedHint: Nobody who works in this branch can do what is ticked here, whatever their teams.
Access.roleTeamsHint: Role teams apply in every branch of the person and are changed on the users screen.
Access.restrictedPerson: This person holds a restricted role: they cannot get another team or an added permission. Only denials can be set.
Access.noBranches: This person works in no branch.
Access.effective: What they can do in this branch now
Access.ownerRowsHint: You change your own rows here; what a delegate gave stays as it is. A denial wins over everything.
Access.delegationHint: A delegate is a person of the branch who may hand out the permissions you choose to the people of that branch.
Access.grantedCount: {count, plural, =0 {nothing handed out yet} one {# item handed out} other {# items handed out}}
Access.ceilingHint: Tick what this person may hand out in the branch. Whatever they give never goes beyond it.
Access.changeCeiling: Change what they may hand out
Access.nothingDrops: Nothing that was handed out stops counting.
Access.willDrop: {count, plural, one {This stops counting:} other {These # stop counting:}}
Access.logHint: The last permission changes: teams, people, branch limits and delegations.
Access.branchHint: The people of your branch, and what you handed out to them within your delegation. What the owner gave is shown read only.
Access.delegatedHint: Only the teams and permissions inside your delegation are offered.

BotRequests.title: Bot booking requests
BotRequests.intro: Requests customers made through the shipping bot. A request is not a booking: staff route it to a branch, open a booking from it or reject it.
BotRequests.byNamesHint: The bot sent this request in the customer's own words. What NOLON could not match is shown as written: choose it when you open the booking.
BotRequests.noQuote: No price from NOLON in this request
BotRequests.botPriceHint: From the bot's own material, not from NOLON's rate cards: check it before you quote.
BotRequests.internalNoteHint: Staff only: never shown to the customer.
BotRequests.reasonsHint: The text the customer reads when a request is rejected. The Administrator adds and edits them.
BotRequests.approveHint: Confirm the customer, the route and what the price is for. NOLON prices it from its rate cards; the booking is saved as a draft with no price, and you can complete it on the booking screen.
BotRequests.checkPriceFirst: Check the price after any change, before you approve.
BotRequests.priceNone_NO_RATE: No approved price for these inputs.
BotRequests.priceNone_UNIT_MISMATCH: The rate card is in another unit: price it on the quotation.
BotRequests.priceNone_AMBIGUOUS: More than one rate card matches: price it on the quotation.
BotRequests.priceFailed: The price could not be checked. Check the inputs.

PaymentInstructions.title: Payment instructions
PaymentInstructions.hint: How a customer pays, for each branch and currency. The shipping bot shows the approved text of an approved request word for word; without one it tells the customer that staff will send how to pay. Another person than the one who wrote it approves it, and an approved text is only retired, never edited.
PaymentInstructions.approved: Approved: it replaces the one before it.
